summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the formatter entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed under Unreleased with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_console.py::test_set_window_title (escape assertion skipped on legacy Windows), test_control.py::test_title, and test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only module). Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
